# Homework, Practicals, and Weekly Quizzes {.unnumbered}

This page lists the Homework, Practical, and Weekly Quiz page for every Unit, so you can find them all in one place. The same link is also at the bottom of each Unit page.

These pages are on the UZH RStudio Connect server. You need to be on a UZH network to open them, so if you are not on campus, connect to the UZH VPN first.
